instruction: Using only the standalone stem, independently free-generate exactly one most likely condition, exactly two priority nursing actions, and exactly two monitoring or evaluation parameters. stem: Stage 3 synthesis: A post-operative client with CKD had a potassium of 3.1 mEq/L. A covering resident ordered potassium chloride 40 mEq in 100 mL normal saline to infuse through a peripheral IV over 1 hour, despite a unit protocol limiting peripheral potassium to 10 mEq/100 mL and 10 mEq/hr and requiring renal-function verification. The nurse questioned the order; the resident insisted it be run without addressing the protocol or eGFR 34 mL/min. The nurse used the chain of command, the unsafe order was not administered, and a revised order of 10 mEq in 100 mL over 1 hour was obtained. Complete the bow-tie diagram.
